shellCommands.command: cat package.json; ls; git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.js' \) -print | grep -v .next | head -50; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null; grep -rl 'forbidden' node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head

cat app/lib/auth.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts; cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; cat 05-config/01-next-config-js/authInterrupts.md 04-functions/forbidden.md 03-file-conventions/forbidden.md
grep -A3 paths tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/ | grep -i unauth; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25

(npx next start -p 3456 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 5; curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3456/admin; grep -o 'Access forbidden\|noindex' /tmp/admin.html | sort -u; pkill -f 'next start' ; git status --short
